 I-380 Traffic Impacts: I-380 Southbound to Penn St & Penn St to I-380 Northbound Overnight Ramp Closure 
 Friday, November 13, 2026 
 I-380 Construction 
 Weather permitting, both the I-380 southbound to Penn St. and the Penn St. to I-380 northbound Ramps will be closed nightly beginning Sunday, November 15, at 10:00 PM through Tuesday, November 17, at 6:00 AM. See the maps provided below for detour details. 
 Closure hours: 
 10:00 PM Sunday, November 15 to 6:00 AM Monday, November 16 
 10:00 PM Monday, November 16 to 6:00 AM Tuesday, November 17
